other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident/domicile of Haryana and have resided in Haryana for the last 5 years at the time of application.
Applicant must not be involved in any unlawful activity.
If the applicant reaches the age of 60 years, the case will be transferred to the Old Age Allowance Scheme.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2750 per month is provided to eligible eunuchs.
documents_required: Certificate from the Civil Surgeon confirming the applicant is an eunuch
